messages:
maya: quick sync  prototyping a compact token pill for the playground stream. mock: https://img.redwood.dev/tmp/compact-pill (mock)
jon: nice. main goals? reduce width and keep actions discoverable.
sam: engineering: pill can expand on focus/click. backend will send token_breakdown and cache_ratio. debounce UI updates to 300ms.
alisha: accessibility: expand must work on keyboard and announce final state with aria-live polite. avoid per-token announcements. contrast of pill text must be >=4.5:1.
maya: UX: collapsed pill shows rounded count (e.g., 1.3k) + cache bolt when applicable. expand shows exact system/prompt/response tokens. stop visible during stream; regenerate appears when idle.
jon: shortcut mapping: Esc = stop, Ctrl/Cmd+R = regenerate (with rate-limit confirmation). update tooltips with shortcuts.
sam: small-screen behavior: collapse regenerate into overflow menu. will add telemetry events: ui.pill_expand, ui.stop_click, ui.regen_click.
alisha: motion: respect prefers-reduced-motion; use instant expand and limit shimmer to first 300ms. I'll create an a11y ticket for contrast and screen reader test steps.
maya: thanks — i'll post a short spec + comps by COB so eng can size it for next sprint. ux-bot: reminder  attach color tokens and keyboard mapping to the spec for QA.
